author: Al3cs
text:
Hi Salivan, hi all,

IMO trading is art and science.

We can learn science side, we can as well study art and artists, we can
have same paper, same pastels, same subject to draw, same all... but the
 deeper part of soul, the talent, is something hard to artificially
build.

Some of us born with special talent, and few have to fortune to unveil what they're born for.

Maybe I am a potential olimpic swimmer but I only take baths for fun,
never been in a pool (I live really near a beautiful beach, btw).

IF is talented and lucky, a really really hard worker and is altruist and is giving most (if not all) of his knowledge for free.

This doesn't mean that there is or will be none like IF, but as for artists, is style is unique.

We can learn from him but we must work hard inside ourselves for
discover our talents (if any) and develop our personal trading style,
not necessary the same exact IF developed for himself. I don't think
there are secrets unveiled. Surely there are new, different personal
patters IF and other Master Traders takes in their private forum.

Salivan you're growing fast as a trader, you're talented too and I'm confident you will be one of next Master Traders.

Take care

OK GUYS

some friends PM me to find the DPs , and how i trade with tight SL . at
first i want to emphasis that this is not my own system (trading with
tight SL) in fact this is real RTM price action reading .this is what a
lot of masters worked on it for years with thousands of hour full time
efforts.if we read all the RTM word by word we can achieve to this LVL
to trade with tight SL and high rewards.this is what all we see in
masters journal like PED,IF,KRUGER,DR,LES-paul,mertch and others master
and traders.

after 6 month here on HWs as a full time student last 3 weeks i decided
 to read the journals of the master and i think i am in last stage . but
 from last week i trade in the way i like it . SL is so important for me
 .i really love stop out if my SL is tight .

bear in mind that it's a long way to achieve to a LVL that you can trade
 as smart money , in my idea nothing is impossible but it need time ,
effort and consistency.so that i am sure one day i will trade WITH OUT
STOP LOSS. and i am sure in that days i spend 90% of my day just looking
 in the chart and just 10% of my time trading.

this is my life , trade is all my life and RTM is a big piece of my life .

my result is not good but i love it , in 60 trades i lost 47 and i won 17 . and this is my resault :

on rule that i am still training with it is this :

imagine WEEKLY time frame is like 1 min TF. then find your zones.
imagine how ITs push price for years to a LVL to drop it in just few
months. imagine how you can trade billions of dollar in your fund and
you want to be profitable in the whole .imagine your job is stop hunting
 for 30 years, imagine Salivan , all you can imagine sure you can
achieve it.

now this is a chart :

i saw it in DR.swing journal , it was interesting for me :

look how RTM traders must trade this chart .

We can see that price always goes from FL to FL, and we just trade this
FLs , and we just trade the LVL that in past some tricks applied. in
those areas of interest we go to LTF and find an other tricks and that
will be our excact DP to trade . with the SL above thae trick zone .

we don't trade the STAR LVLs for long term position but we can trade
them for some bounces because we know that there are orders in that
interest area. we look for approach in to our interest area if CP or 3
derive good sign, we look for those areas that BO traders must joint
ther and novice traders must join . all this scenario always repeat .
this is why they can not hide thier intentions. for thier intentions we
use ENG, but which ENG ??? we use ENG of FLs. why ???bcz the only place
that price must hold is in FLs , hold price down or up . so if FL ENG
then we know that thier intention changed in and we must look for future
 tricks .

for our TPs we have two ways :

let PA take you out, or if you short a lvl just close your trade in the place that you are ready for long .

this is all i learnt from masters in this period of time .

i thanks all of them and all the traders that were been active . i thank IF and i thank RTM to share knowledge with me .

hope i can help traders

hope i can be useful here and i try my best here to pay my debt to new members in future .

best regards
